title: tag
about: menu-to-level1's steps into level 1, which has no paint gun (level1.xml has no gun pickup; the first is in level 2): walk forward into the goal at the alley's end, through the loading screen into level 2, forward onto the green (jump) gun's pedestal, which gives the gun, then paint: a shot at the floor beyond the fence (left button), a turn to the left and a shot at the wall, then the right button at the same place (erase). Each shot is a second or more after the last motion (the oracle's clock is the wall's, ours is virtual).
